title: Local perfect models recovered from an open restriction
statement: Let X be a scheme and U an open subset. Use the derived categories of module sheaves on X and U and their localized open sites [def-pc-derived-category], and exact open restriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. If E in D(O_X) restricts to a perfect object on U [def-pc-perfect-complex], then at every x in U there is an ambient open A containing x and a strictly perfect complex K on the localized site at A with E restricted to A isomorphic to Q(K). No assertion at points outside U is made.

source.place: Definition 08CM; locality paragraph of the proof of Lemma 08DP

proof.text: At x in U obtain a strictly perfect model K on a neighbourhood W in U from the given perfectness. Put A = U.ι image W, so A contains x. The scheme isomorphism U.ι.isoImage W identifies W.toScheme with A.toScheme. Compose Modules.overEquiv W, exact restriction along this isomorphism inverse, and (Modules.overEquiv A).inverse to form the exact equivalence H between the localized module categories. Its unit isomorphism and coproduct comparison identify H of every finite free module with the corresponding finite free module. Applying H termwise preserves the bounds and the retraction equations, yielding a strictly perfect K'.

Compose overFunctorEquiv W, overFunctorEquiv U, restrictFunctorComp and isoImage_inv_ι, then cancel overEquiv A by its unit. This gives the underived square: restriction to U followed by restriction to W and H is restriction to A. Derive the square with mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso. Apply it to E, compose with the image under H.mapDerivedCategory of the original model isomorphism, and use H.mapDerivedCategoryFactors to identify the last object with Q(K'). Empty U is vacuous and U=X is the same transport construction.

lean.statement:
theorem open_restriction_perfect_local_models (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : U.toScheme.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (hE : IsPerfect U.toScheme ((schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E))
    (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    ∃ A : X.Opens, x ∈ A ∧
      ∃ K : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over A)) ℤ,
        IsStrictlyPerfect X A K ∧
        Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
          (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) A).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅
            DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)
